about: Days from the FSSP seminary's published 2026 calendar (fsspolgs.org/liturgical-calendar, read 2026-11-09) chosen because comparing with Missale Meum alone cannot catch them. 'printed' is the seminary's own wording.

days.printed: Feria of Lent, III class; commemorations: Seven Dolours of Our Lady, St. John Damascene
days.tests: a second commemoration on a III class feria

days.printed: Christ the King, I class; no commemoration
days.tests: a feast of the Lord takes the Sunday with no commemoration (no. 17(d))

days.printed: All Saints, I class; commemoration: Twenty third Sunday after Pentecost
days.tests: a I class feast that is not of the Lord keeps the Sunday as a privileged commemoration (no. 108(a))

days.printed: (USA) St. Frances Xavier Cabrini, Virgin, III class; commemoration: St. Didacus, Confessor
days.tests: a national III class feast displaces a universal III class feast, which is commemorated

days.printed: St. Andrew, Apostle, II class; commemoration: Feria of Advent
days.tests: an Advent feria is commemorated on a II class feast
